Adventure.title: The Bad Guys
Adventure.description: A clever gang of notorious animal thieves attempts to change their reputation by becoming model citizens, but an unexpected mission challenges their loyalty, friendship, and every choice they make.

Adventure.title: The Bad Guys 2
Adventure.description: The reformed crew is pulled into another thrilling adventure where fresh rivals, daring missions, and unexpected twists push their teamwork, courage, and trust to exciting new limits together.

Adventure.title: The Croods
Adventure.description: A prehistoric family leaves the safety of their familiar cave to explore a colorful world filled with danger, discovery, and unforgettable adventures that reshape their future forever together.

Adventure.title: The Croods: A New Age
Adventure.description: The adventurous Croods discover a new paradise and meet another family whose modern lifestyle sparks hilarious conflicts, surprising friendships, and exciting lessons about living together happily.

Adventure.title: How to Train Your Dragon
Adventure.description: A young Viking forms an unlikely friendship with a mysterious dragon, changing the future of his village while discovering courage, compassion, and the true meaning of being a hero.

Adventure.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
Adventure.description: As new dangers threaten the peace between dragons and humans, Hiccup embarks on an unforgettable journey filled with breathtaking discoveries, difficult choices, and powerful family connections.

Adventure.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
Adventure.description: Hiccup and Toothless face their greatest challenge as a mysterious hidden realm, powerful enemies, and life-changing decisions test their friendship and the future they hope to protect.

Adventure.title: Epic
Adventure.description: A teenage girl is transported into a hidden forest kingdom where tiny heroes fight to protect nature, leading to an unforgettable adventure filled with bravery, friendship, and hope.

Adventure.title: Puss in Boots
Adventure.description: The fearless and charming Puss in Boots sets out on a daring quest packed with legendary adventures, clever escapes, unforgettable allies, and thrilling battles that test his courage.

Adventure.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
Adventure.description: Facing his greatest challenge yet, Puss in Boots begins an extraordinary journey to reclaim hope, confront his fears, and discover what truly makes every adventure worth living.

Adventure.title: Strange World
Adventure.description: A family of explorers ventures into a mysterious land filled with extraordinary creatures, incredible discoveries, and unexpected challenges that reveal the importance of unity and understanding.
